normative_extracts.quote: The reference pixel is the visual angle of one pixel on a device with a pixel density of 96dpi and a distance from the reader of an arm’s length.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Layout uses fixed-point subpixel units (1/64th px in Blink); Paint snaps borders to device pixels while transforms may land between pixels.

production_failures.symptom: HTML5 <canvas> drawings and text look blurry on Retina/HiDPI screens
production_failures.root_cause: Canvas backing store width/height attributes default to CSS pixels (1x) instead of scaling by window.devicePixelRatio.
production_failures.mitigation: Multiply canvas.width/height by devicePixelRatio, keep CSS size unchanged, and call ctx.scale(dpr, dpr).

production_failures.symptom: Text inside a centered modal turns blurry during or after a CSS transform
production_failures.root_cause: translate(-50%, -50%) on an odd-pixel element height produces a 0.5px physical offset.
production_failures.mitigation: Prefer Flexbox/Grid centering over translate(-50%, -50%) or round transform offsets to device-pixel boundaries.
